detail.longDescription: I am building a service radius calculator for a local business web app. I am intermittently getting ZERO_RESULTS from the Google Maps Distance Matrix API, even though the addresses are completely valid and show up correctly on the standard Google Maps website. Here is my current JavaScript implementation: JavaScript async function calculateDistance(origin, destination) { const apiKey = 'MY_API_KEY'; const url = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/distancematrix/json?origins=${origin}&destinations=${destination}&key=${apiKey}`; try { const response = await fetch(url); const data = await response.json(); console.log(data); } catch (error) { console.error("Error fetching distance:", error); } } // Example addresses returning ZERO_RESULTS calculateDistance('123 Main St, Billings, MT', '456 Elm St, Billings, MT'); I have checked my API key restrictions and billing, and both are fine. Does the Distance Matrix API require a specific URL encoding format for local US addresses, or is there a parameter I am missing?
